en: You're the angel's hero, aren't you? Now that we've been summoned, there's no victory for you. Here I come!
Don't get cocky just because you beat me. I'll be waiting for you in hell...
Who... could have done this...
Go get ready to die, and try again! Wahahaha!
Wahahaha! The angel's hero is like a babe in arms!
Larva
Welcome, angel's hero. I don't even need a camp like this.{wait}{clear}It's such a bother... So I'll just kill you humans off quick!
You... I'll make sure you never talk like that again...
Ahahaha! What a funny thing to say! Then let's see what you can do!!
H-how... could I...
You... who summoned you? Answer me!
Hmph... Who called me... I don't remember. It doesn't... matter anyway...{wait}{clear}Hehehe... go ahead and suffer... It's all just beginning... Ahahaha...!
No human can beat me. Not even the angel's hero. Ahahaha!
What, running away? Humans really are boring.
Hehehe... So the angel's hero is no more than this after all...
King's Lady
Where do you think you're going?{wait}{clear}Depending on your answer, your journey ends here.
That's none of your concern...
Fool! Turn to dust right here and vanish!!
The castle vanished...{wait}{clear}Is it telling me not to go any further...?
I trust you witnessed my work,{wait}{clear}my king, Lord Ravenruft.
They ran away... Ohohohoho...
We won't let mere humans interfere with us!
Humans are no match for us!
It ran away!
Why did you, a hero, become a vampire?
Answer me!
It can't be helped...
......{wait}{clear}I'm sorry...
On whose orders are you after me?
Ngh... Not here...
Foot Soldier
Long live His Majesty the Emperor!
Tindalos
Stop this stupid ritual!
As a Warlock, a case like this makes me angry...
The meaning of our ritual... is beyond you...
So you've come, angel's hero. Show me just how strong you are!
So this is the power of demons...
Ahahaha! What a pathetic hero!
I'll defeat you all!
Awoooo!!
Hmph, angel's hero or not, you're only human. You can't hope to match me!{wait}{clear}Here I come!
Fuhahaha! Come back when you're ready!
So that's a hero?! Fuhahahahaha...!
Was it you who attacked the village...?
If you come at me, I'll cut you down...
Get out of here...
...Worthless lot...
What did you say?! If you mean to get in our way, die!
The angel's hero...
You've come to feed my cursed sword...
You're the one going down, devil knight.
Hmph, my cursed sword is invincible... I won't lose to the likes of you!
The cursed sword has taken your soul...
Ngh... There's no end to them...
Too scared to even make a sound?!
You think you look cool? Here we come!!
Become rust on my blade.
Is that all...?
Monsters in the Imperial Army...?
You lot...
You're the one going down...
What? I'll crush you...
You... still saying that...
I'll be waiting for you in hell...
...Even out here...
Damn it... You people...
...The Empire...
It's nothing to do with me, but I can't forgive the Empire's ways...
...Pointless...
It's nothing to do with me, but I won't forgive the Empire's ways...
This world has no need for demons...
It's foolish humans this world has no need for!
...Demons... I'll destroy them...
Are you mad for blood too...?
I'll finish you off in no time...
What?! You wanna die, punk?!
...I don't like water... but it can't be helped... I'll end this quickly.
Water... no thanks...
I'll finish this quickly.
Anyone in my way, I cut down.
Is it over...?
Dealing with you is a waste of time... I'll finish this quickly.
Undead, as I thought...
The dead should return to the earth...
So it was a banshee after all...
So you're the ones attacking the village...
You're... a demon...
Who are you?
Leave the village quietly...
You lot...
Oh my...? I'm honored you came to see me. You're welcome to stay here forever, you know?
...I'm going to destroy you...
Come at me, and I'll cut you down.
It's over...
So the cause was a chimera...
That should do it...
Are you the ones raiding this area?
As I thought... Walk the road to ruin, the lot of you...
How could one of the king's blood do such a thing?!
Go to hell...
You're nowhere near the king!
So you're the ones who killed the villagers...
It's over.
So these are the ones who took the children...
...It's over...
Why did you attack the village?
I don't like water... but I'll take you down...
So the voice was a sea dragon...
Well, well... the king's own son, the fool led astray by an angel...{wait}{clear}Have you decided to beg our king's forgiveness?
Forgiveness...?{wait}{clear}You'll be the one begging his forgiveness for failing to kill me... in hell...
I will never forgive your kind...
Hahahaha...! You're not fit to stand at the king's feet!
You... what are you...?
What are you planning?
Demons and humans joining hands...
Hehehe... Then I shall offer you to the king!
Hehehehe... You're still no match for the king!
So it's you...
That's enough of your mouth...
Demons in this forest...
So it was a Shadow...
Will even the Holy City fall to the Empire...?
Is it over...?{wait}{clear}What! More of them?!
This march is led by Lord Alberic, the Empire's foremost knight. Do not hinder the march he leads himself!
...It's nothing to do with me...
What did you say?! If you defy us, die!!
Lord Alberic... forgive me...{wait}{clear}Ugh...
Pointless...
You seem to have grown quite strong...
Then I'll stop holding back.
So what the angel said was true... Why are these things...
I have no intention of joining your pointless talk either...
Vanish...
Hmph, big words... The real suffering for you lot starts now. Ahahaha!
Vampire Blas
Of the king's blood, you say... Hmph, don't make me laugh...{wait}{clear}Ha ha ha...
Hmph, fine skill.{wait}{clear}But the time is not yet ripe. Begone!{wait}{clear}Hahahahaha......
Wait, Ravenruft! Fight me!!
Did you witness my work,{wait}{clear}my king, Lord Ravenruft?
They ran away... Ohohohoho...
I trust you witnessed my work,{wait}{clear}my king, Lord Ravenruft.
We won't let mere humans interfere with us!
To think you're the heir to the king's blood...
Your half-human blood is your weakness!
Damn... There's no end to them...
On my own...{wait}{clear}I have no choice but to fall back...
Stop this nonsense...
I have no time to waste on you...!
Rudi
Are you the ones who attacked the village?
If you're gonna hurt people, I'll take you down!
Easy as that!
Stop this march!!
The purpose of this march is...
That was a creepy one.
What is the Empire trying to do...?
How long are you going to keep this up?!!
None of your business!
What's with these Imperial guys...?
I'm not gonna be anybody's prey!
A man whose soul was taken by a cursed sword...{wait}{clear}How sad...
What...!!
I'll turn the tables on you!
Even a village like this...
Awful... this is too awful...
Ugh! Undead really are gross. I'll take 'em out fast!
That's the end of it...
I've got no name to give you! Here I come!
What are you...?
I'm no good with this kind of thing...
You're the ones who need to get out of here, now!
The village should be fine now.
Serenis?{wait}{clear}Are you working for the Empire too?!
Why do you hate this world so much?
None of your business... I'll be waiting for you in hell...
Viper...
What is the Empire thinking?!
What is the Empire trying to start?
Stop picking on the weak! What good does this do?!
Those Imperials... I can't forgive them...
Like I'd ever obey you guys!
Against the Empire, there's no end to it... At this rate...
Stop tormenting innocent people! What good does this do?!
Even if I win, this...
Why is something like this with the Imperial Army?! What on earth happened?
Foolish humans could never understand... Die!
I never thought it'd come to this... Damn it!! But I won't give up... not me...
Whoa! This stench of blood is awful...! I'll clean these guys up fast!
That was gross...
This village sits on the main highway to Granis. I'll get rid of any monster running wild here!
Easy as that.
So you're the cowards who only go after women! I'll take you down!
